note: Rustic state forest campground on the southeast corner of Sandy Beach Lake, with an on-site attendant, a separate sandy beach and picnic area beside it and a boat landing just before the entrance. Sites 1917-1933 line the lake side of the loop, in the woods. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (downgrade): stored lakefront -> lakeview. The lake-side sites (1917, 1919, 1921, 1923, 1925, 1928, 1930, 1931, 1933 per the brochure map) all sit under continuous forest canopy on Esri z19 and NAIP; the shore of the main lake and of the lily-pad bay at the south end (about 46.1020,-89.9688) is wooded all round, with no open pad or clearing at the waterline. Nothing shows a drive-in site on open ground within ~50 m of the water, so lakefront is not earned; the lake lies just beyond a tree band from the west-side sites, which supports a filtered lakeview. The stored evidence 'RV 1921-1931 on the all-sand-bottom lake shore' has no source on any page read (the 'large sandy beach' is the separate day-use beach and picnic area).
